words.prose: {{ar:ثُمَّ}} ({{tr:thumma}}) opens the ayah as a delayed sequence marker, not a flat additive "and." After the tighter immediate linkage of the previous command pair in 69:30, it slows the punishment into another procedural stage: the condemned person is first seized and bound, then the fire-command is introduced as a fresh escalation. Its scope reaches over the whole unit {{ar:ٱلْجَحِيمَ صَلُّوهُ}} ({{tr:al-jaḥīma ṣallūhu}}), so the particle connects the prior imperatives to the entire next command, not just to the following noun. The order it sets up is hinge, destination, execution: {{ar:ثُمَّ}} ({{tr:thumma}}), then the displayed fire, then the final imperative. Because the word is a fixed particle rather than an inflected verb, the staging work is carried by the connector itself before the command morphology arrives; its doubled mīm makes that connective hinge a held beat before the fire noun appears.

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْجَحِيمَ}} ({{tr:al-jaḥīma}}) is definite and singular, so the command names the known fire-destination rather than introducing an unspecified blaze. Its accusative fronting puts that destination before the imperative: the fire is displayed first, and {{ar:صَلُّوهُ}} ({{tr:ṣallūhu}}) then executes what has already been placed in view. The grammar can be heard as direct governed object and as destination or medium of exposure, so the noun is not a decorative place word; it is the environment into which the command sends the condemned person and the heat by which the punishment is endured. The {{ar:ج ح م}} ({{tr:j-ḥ-m}}) branch narrows here to blazing fire and intense ember-heat, while wider branches such as battle intensity, glowing eyes, anger-flare, or little modesty do not control the local sense. That heat-register links naturally with the following {{ar:صَلُّوهُ}} ({{tr:ṣallūhu}}), a recurrent fire-exposure pairing seen also in 83:16, 37:163, and 56:94. The joined opening {{ar:ثُمَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ}} ({{tr:thumma al-jaḥīma}}) also lets the connector flow directly into a harsh-centered heat word before the imperative closes the ayah. Even the ayah boundary shifts scale: after the bodily restraint of 69:30, this word presents an encompassing fire realm before the execution command lands.

words.prose: {{ar:صَلُّوهُ}} ({{tr:ṣallūhu}}) is the clause's final imperative, and its Form II shape makes the command causative: the addressed plural agents are ordered to make the condemned person endure the fire, not merely to report that he burns. The attached {{ar:هُ}} ({{tr:-hu}}) keeps the same singular patient moving through the command chain from 69:30, while the plural ending keeps the executors grammatically present even though no subject noun is named. Its frame is transitive and compressed: the fronted {{ar:ٱلْجَحِيمَ}} ({{tr:al-jaḥīma}}) supplies the fire destination or medium, and the suffix supplies the person acted upon. The {{ar:ص ل ي}} ({{tr:ṣ-l-y}}) range is narrowed here to fire exposure and endured heat; prayer, blessing, following, trap, back/haunch, place, slab, and plant branches remain outside the local sense, though the prayer or orientation neighborhood can survive only as a contrast because the fire noun resolves the ambiguity. Within that fire field, this is a smaller command-form realization beside larger imperfect, Form IV, participle, and verbal-noun exposure patterns, including the exposure vocabulary in 56:94. Its emphatic ṣād and doubled lām give the word a dense sound shape that matches the Form II causative pressure. As the last word, the imperative completes the ayah's connector-destination-execution sequence and the larger 69:30-31 progression from seizing to binding to burning.

topics.reason: QAC identifies the local verb as Form II causative, and V4 includes the fire-exposure branch for {{ar:ص ل ي}} ({{tr:ṣ-l-y}}).

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The fronted object ٱلْجَحِيمَ at word 2 is followed by the transitive plural imperative صَلُّوهُ at word 3.
baseline_models.mechanism: The blaze supplies an intensely hot destination, while both mapped ص ل ي inventories converge on being made to meet, enter, and suffer fire. Object fronting makes that medium more salient than the agents executing the command.

activation_trace.role: Blazing fire and intense heat supply the destination and dominant physical medium.
Encountering, entering, or being made to suffer fire supplies the commanded exposure.
The non-dominant mapped root independently supplies meeting fire and enduring its heat, reinforcing the direct reading.

changed_reading.before: A bare command to consign him to Hell.
changed_reading.after: The fronted blaze is the operative medium: the imperative makes him enter and endure its concentrated heat.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The collocation of ٱلْجَحِيمَ with صَلُّوهُ joins the furnace-like noun at word 2 to a fire-working branch of the verb at word 3.
baseline_models.mechanism: Beyond arrival at a place, the fire-working branch includes kindling, roasting, and turning an object over flame to straighten it. The commanded person can therefore be construed as material subjected to an active thermal process.

activation_trace.role: The intensely blazing fire supplies the furnace conditions for processing rather than mere relocation.
Kindling, roasting, and fire-straightening supply the image of a body actively worked by heat.

changed_reading.before: The command only moves him into a fiery location.
changed_reading.after: The command subjects him to a sustained operation of kindling, roasting, or heat-straightening.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The object suffix in صَلُّوهُ makes the condemned the handled target, while the ص ل ي inventories at word 3 contain set-snare branches.
baseline_models.mechanism: The causative handling can be spatialized as capture: the blaze is not only approached but closes as a trap around its object. This remains secondary to the direct fire sense.

activation_trace.role: The blazing, ember-filled destination gives the proposed snare its destructive enclosure.
Snares and traps supply the constrictive capture image applied to the commanded object.
The parallel set-snare image in the split mapping confirms that the capture resonance is not confined to one mapped root.

changed_reading.before: He is placed near or inside fire.
changed_reading.after: He is made the caught object of a fiery enclosure from which exposure and capture coincide.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The same ص ل ي occurrence at word 3 maps to inventories that include prescribed, binding worship as well as fire exposure; the clause itself is an imperative directed through plural officiants.
baseline_models.mechanism: The worship branches permit a disturbing counter-ritual echo: the commanded body undergoes a compulsory fire-act where ordinary prayer would be willing worship. This is a resonance, not a replacement translation of صَلُّوهُ.

activation_trace.role: The blazing object converts the worship echo into an explicitly punitive counter-rite.
Binding ritual prayer supplies the compulsory-worship resonance carried by the imperative.
Prescribed worship in the second mapped inventory keeps the rite resonance live across the split root.

changed_reading.before: The fire command has no relation to the worship field also carried by the root.
changed_reading.after: The imperative bears an exploratory echo of coerced counter-worship performed through bodily exposure to the blaze.

context_deltas.mechanism: A judgment-establishing record, accounting, and a cutting decision turn the focus imperative from an isolated threat into execution of an adjudicated sentence. The blaze is what the record and reckoning now make operative.

activation_trace.role: The intensely hot blaze supplies the concrete sanction executed by the command.
Being made to enter and suffer fire supplies the act by which the sentence is carried out.
A written fixing that imposes judgment supplies the documentary basis for the later imperative.
Counting and accounting supply the reckoning that precedes execution.
A cutting judgment supplies the sentence the speaker wishes had already ended the matter.

structural_cues: The received book and account precede the wish for a final decision, after which the same person becomes the object of serial imperatives.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a binding record, accounting, and cutting judgment; I supply the arrow that the focus command executes their sentence. A live alternative is simple narrative succession without a formal legal mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The verse abruptly orders a physical punishment.
changed_reading.after: The verse is the execution clause of a recorded and accounted judgment, with fire as the due sanction.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the wish for an ending and the loss of authority, seizure and collaring precede the focus; a measured linked chain and insertion follow it. The follower branch of ص ل ي and the repeated sequencing make fire exposure the middle, nonterminal station of a controlled transfer.

activation_trace.role: The follower immediately behind a leader supplies the image of this command following one custody stage and leading into another.
The blazing fire supplies the thermal station within the transfer sequence.
Completion and ending supply the wished-for terminus that the following stages explicitly deny.
Power and authority, now lost, supply the agency reversal that makes the former possessor a handled object.
Seizure and capture supply the first custodial operation on the object.
A collar that binds an organ supplies bodily restraint immediately before fire exposure.
Connected links supply the continuing apparatus after the fire stage.
Measurement by the cubit makes the apparatus deliberate and quantified rather than chaotic.
Inserting one thing into another supplies the next handling operation and proves the fire stage is not terminal.

structural_cues: 69:30, 69:31, and 69:32 use plural imperatives with the same masculine singular object suffix, and two occurrences of ثُمَّ order the operations.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies loss of authority, capture, restraint, linked measurement, insertion, and follower imagery; I infer a deliberately ordered custody process. The alternative is a cumulative list of punishments with no transfer mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The verse is an isolated act of burning and possible endpoint.
changed_reading.after: The person is serially handled through custody, fire, and measured chaining; fire exposure is a middle station, not an endpoint.

context_deltas.mechanism: The local context supplies both missing what is right and a straight, faceward insertion image, while the focus inventory supplies straightening an object over fire. Together they let the thermal process read as a punitive counter-form to misalignment, without implying rehabilitation.

activation_trace.role: Turning a stick over fire to straighten it supplies the literal material analogy for imposed alignment.
Intense blazing heat supplies the force by which the proposed straightening is imposed.
A straight thrust directed toward the face supplies a local image of forcibly imposed linear alignment.
Passing beyond and failing to hit what is right supplies the misalignment reversed by fire-straightening.

structural_cues: The fire command is followed by straight insertion into a chain and then by naming those who miss what is right, but the focus contains no language of restoration or mercy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies missing the right target, straight insertion, and fire-straightening; I supply the mirrored arrow from misalignment to imposed alignment. A live alternative is that these branches contribute only sin, chaining, and roasting without a shared directional mechanism.

changed_reading.after: The heat also forms an exploratory image of forced straightening for one locally marked as missing what is right and then inserted along a straight course.

context_deltas.mechanism: Failure even to urge feeding another is followed by a punishment complex framed by food and eating. The focus fire-working branch includes kindling and fuel, while the eating inventory includes feeding a fire into ignition, allowing the condemned to become what is fed to the blaze before receiving degraded food himself.

activation_trace.role: The ember-rich blazing fire supplies the consuming recipient in the feeding reversal.
Kindling, fuel, and roasting supply the material treatment that lets the person be construed as fed into fire.
Urging toward an act supplies the omitted social action for which the punishment gives a reversal.
Feeding another and seeking food identify nourishment as the specific neglected relation.
Feeding a fire and making it ignite supplies the direct bridge from the later eating clause back to the focus blaze.

structural_cues: 69:33-34 state the failures explaining the preceding punishment, and 69:36-37 immediately recast its aftermath in food and eating terms.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies neglected feeding, fire-kindling, feeding fire, and degraded food; I infer a talionic arrow in which the condemned becomes fuel. The live alternative is that hunger and fire are parallel punishments without person-as-fuel imagery.

changed_reading.before: The focus describes combustion unrelated to the later food accusation.
changed_reading.after: The blaze enacts a feeding reversal: one who would not support feeding another is fed into fire and then assigned debased food.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it personifies a fiery destination as an eye. It remains anchored because the focus ج ح م inventory explicitly supplies a glowing or staring eye, the focus ص ل ي branch supplies encounter, and the local context supplies two things meeting face to face. Downstream prose should render it only as a secondary confrontation resonance, never as a replacement meaning for Hellfire.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ٱلْجَحِيمَ at word 2 carries the eye branch, while صَلُّوهُ at word 3 commands an encounter with it.

activation_trace.role: The glowing or staring eye supplies the blaze-as-gaze image.
Being made to encounter fire turns the eye image into forced face-to-face exposure.

changed_reading.before: The blaze is only an impersonal source of heat.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the condemned is forced into face-to-face confrontation with a staring blaze.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the prescribed-prayer branches are form-distant from the causative fire sense in the focus. It remains valid as a resonance because both mapped ص ل ي inventories carry worship, the focus is imperative, and the local stated offense is failed faith in the worshipped deity. Downstream prose must label it an inverted-rite echo rather than translate صَلُّوهُ as prayer.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The split-mapped صَلُّوهُ at word 3 carries both fire and prescribed-worship branches, and the fronted blaze at word 2 makes any ritual echo coercive and punitive.

activation_trace.role: The intensely blazing object supplies the punitive medium that inverts the worship image.
Binding ritual prayer supplies the compulsory-rite resonance within the focus imperative.
Prescribed worship in the second mapped root keeps the resonance live across the split mapping.
Heart-settling belief supplies the refused voluntary posture that the counter-rite coercively reverses.
Worship and the worshipped deity identify the ritual field implicated by the stated failure.

changed_reading.before: The command is purely penal and outside the worship field.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, refused faith and worship return as a coerced anti-liturgy in which the body is made to undergo the blaze.

strongest_changes: The focus becomes the execution point of a recorded and accounted sentence rather than an isolated threat.
Repeated imperatives and sequencing markers make fire exposure a nonterminal stage in measured custody.
The food branches support a talionic reversal from neglected feeding to being fed into the blaze and receiving degraded food.
Deviation cues strengthen the secondary fire-straightening image as punitive imposed alignment.
summary.what_was_special: The split ص ل ي inventory let the direct fire sense coexist with fire-working, snare, follower, and worship images. The immediate seizure-fire-chain sequence activated the follower and trap fields, while the later causal accusations activated a distinct feeding reversal.
remaining_uncertainties: The fire-straightening branch may be only a material analogy rather than a contextually intended reversal of deviation.
The person-as-fuel arrow is coherent but inferred; the text can instead coordinate separate fire and hunger punishments.
The staring-eye and counter-rite readings should remain explicitly exploratory because each relies on a form-distant branch image.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Custody proceeds into forced heat exposure.** **ج ح م B001** (blazing fire and intense heat) and **ص ل ي B003** (encountering fire and its heat) follow shackling with `ثم`. The packet supplies ordered capture, restraint, and insertion into heat; I infer escalation from immobilization to environmental punishment. The ayah reads as the second stage of a specified process.
2. **An inverted adjacency to worship.** **ص ل ي B001** (ritual prayer as binding worship) is lexically nearby but form and object select B003; nevertheless 69:33's failure of faith activates an exploratory reversal. The packet supplies rejected worship and compelled fire-contact; I infer a stark substitution of one binding encounter for another. This is a contextual resonance, not a claim that the verb here denotes prayer.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 69:33-34 supplies the surprising explanatory turn from material punishment to failed faith and failed social urging; the heat scene is morally diagnosed after it is ordered.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The blaze is an environment and a terminal encounter.** `ج ح م` B001 is "blazing fire and intense heat," while B002 is "battle or death at a blaze"; `ص ل ي` B003 is "encountering fire and its heat." The fronted `ٱلْجَحِيمَ` makes the destination precede the command, and the chain instruction follows. B001 supplies the medium; B002/B003 assign the entry an adversarial, bodily encounter-role. The packet supplies forced movement into heat; I infer that coercion removes any possibility of distance from the environment. The ayah reads as compelled contact with an overpowering blaze, not merely placement near fire.
2. **Fire-straightening becomes a punitive counter-formation.** `ص ل ي` B004 includes "kindling, roasting, and fire-straightening." The person who did not orient toward account (69:26) and whose authority failed is now commanded into fire before being threaded through a chain. B004 gives heat the role of materially straightening or re-forming what enters it. The packet supplies moral nonalignment and a bodily fire process; I infer a punitive analogy misalignment -> coercive straightening, not a claim of rehabilitation. `صَلُّوهُ` thus carries the harsh craft-image of working material by fire.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 69:37, just beyond the original window, adds forced eating to the fire-and-chain environment. That creates an anti-feast in which `ص ل ي` B004's roasting/fire-working stands opposite the wholesome eating of 69:24: the person is worked by heat while receiving corrupt intake. The later eater-class confirms that the material process is adjudicated, not indiscriminate combustion.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, büyük bir ateşin güçlü biçimde harlanmasını, ısısının yakıcılığını, korların üst üste birikmesini ve çok sıcak bir yeri aynı anlam alanında toplar. Dalın ateş ve yoğun sıcaklık çerçevesi bu kapsamı doğru biçimde yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, ateşin ve sıcaklığın yüksek derecesiyle sınırlıdır; daralma, hırs veya cimrilik anlatan inceleme birimi çekirdek anlama katılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın olmayan ateş ve sıcak yer kullanımlarını ayrı yönleriyle korur; inceleme birimindeki daralma ve iç yanması anlamını dala genellemez.

concept_map.definition: Çok güçlü biçimde harlanan büyük ateşi, onun yakıcı sıcaklığını ve ateş kadar sıcak bir yeri anlatır. Üst üste biriken korlar veya bir ateşin üstüne yakılan başka ateş bu yoğunluğun somut görünümüdür.

facets.statement: Ateş güçlü biçimde harlanır, büyür ve yakıcı bir sıcaklık verir.
Ateşin ısı niteliği, dayanılması güç derecede sıcak bir yeri nitelemeye uzanır.
Korların üst üste yığılması veya bir ateşin üstüne başka ateş yakılması büyük ateşin örnekleridir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, anlamı harlanmış büyük ateş, güçlü yanma ve yakıcı sıcaklık çevresinde birleştirir; kor yığını ile aşırı sıcak yer bu çekirdeğin somutlaşan yönleridir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü tek bir dışa çıkık veya ateşli göz biçimini değil, bazı yerel kullanımlarda gözün adını, aslanın gözlerini, gözleri dikerek açmayı, keskin bakışı, iri kızıl göz niteliğini ve bir göz hastalığını birlikte verir. Dal korunabilir, ancak geçici göz görüntüsü bu farklı yönlerin yalnız bir bölümünü temsil eder.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Ateşli görünüm bütün kullanımların zorunlu niteliği değildir; göz adı, bakış eylemi, görünüş özelliği ve hastalık ayrı yönler olarak tutulur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yerel göz adını ve gözle kurulan yapılara bağlı eylem, nitelik ve hastalık anlamlarını ayırır; tek bir yalın göz biçimine indirgemez.

concept_map.definition: Bazı yerel kullanımlarda gözün adını ve özellikle aslanın gözlerini; gözleri dikerek açma veya keskin bakma eylemini; iri ve koyu kızıl göz niteliğini; ayrıca gözleri şişiren bir hastalığı kapsar.

facets.statement: Sözcük bazı yerel kullanımlarda doğrudan gözün adı olarak kullanılır.
Aslanın iki gözü, parıldayan veya ateşli görünüşleriyle özel olarak adlandırılır.
Gözleri bir noktaya dikerek açma ve birine keskin bakma eylemleri anlatılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi ateşin sıcaklığına maruz kalmayı, ateş yanında ısınmayı, bir şeyi ateşle pişirip yakmayı, ateşe atmayı, yakacağı ve zorluğa katlanma aktarımını birlikte doğrular.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Ateşle doğrudan karşılaşma çekirdektir; pişirme, yakma, düzeltme, yakacak ve zorluğa katlanma kullanımları ayrı tutulur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın biçimlerin ateş ve yakacak anlamlarını korurken yalnız belirli kuruluşlarda görülen ısınma, düzeltme ve zorluğa katlanma anlamlarını genelleştirmez.

concept_map.definition: Ateşin içine girerek ya da yanında bulunarak onun yakıcı sıcaklığına maruz kalmayı anlatır; ateşte eti pişirme ile değneği ateşte yumuşatıp düzeltme gibi ateşle işleme anlamları belirli kuruluşlara bağlıdır. Ateşi besleyen yakacak adı ile bir işin ağır sıkıntısını çekme anlamı bu çekirdeğe bağlı özel kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Bir varlık ateşe girer, ateşin yanında kalır veya onun yakıcı sıcaklığını ve şiddetini çeker.
Kişi ateşin yanında durarak onun sıcaklığıyla ısınır.
Belirli kuruluşlarda et ateşte pişirilir veya değnek ateşte yumuşatılıp düzeltilir.
Ad biçimi ateşi tutuşturup sürdürmeye yarayan yakacağı, ayrıca ateşte pişirme işini belirtebilir.
Ateşin yakıcılığı, bir işin ağırlığını ve sıkıntısını çekmeye aktarılır.
